expectations.text: Report contains at least one Critical severity finding
expectations.evidence: Report has '### CRITICAL' section with 4 findings (C-1 through C-4). Line 12: '### CRITICAL'

expectations.text: At least one finding references a specific file path under src/services/AuctionKings
expectations.evidence: Multiple findings reference exact paths with line numbers e.g. 'src/services/AuctionKings.API/Program.cs:1-43', 'src/services/AuctionKings.Application/Auctions/Commands/PlaceBid/PlaceBidCommand.cs:6-10'

expectations.text: Report identifies the missing UseAuthentication middleware
expectations.evidence: C-1 finding explicitly states: 'UseAuthentication() is also absent from the middleware pipeline.' and remediation includes 'app.UseAuthentication() immediately before app.UseAuthorization()'

expectations.text: Report identifies IDOR / horizontal privilege escalation via BidderId in command handlers
expectations.evidence: C-3 finding: 'PlaceBidCommand.BidderId and CreateAuctionCommand.SellerId come directly from the request body. An authenticated user can trivially supply any other user's GUID and act as that user.'

expectations.text: Report calls out AllowAdmin=true on Redis
expectations.evidence: H-6 finding: 'src/services/AuctionKings.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs:53 — redisConfig.AllowAdmin = true. AllowAdmin flag enables FLUSHDB, FLUSHALL, CONFIG SET...'
Every finding has a '- **Remediation**:' subsection with specific, actionable guidance including code snippets

expectations.text: Report credits security controls that are correctly implemented
expectations.evidence: '## Positive Findings' section lists 11 bullet points crediting self-bid protection, dual concurrency tokens, concurrency retry loop, Docker secrets pattern, no raw SQL, etc.
